name: τ²-Bench Retail
description: The retail domain split of τ²-bench (tau2-bench), evaluating conversational agents in a dual-control environment where both the AI agent and the user can independently invoke tools. Modeled as a Dec-POMDP, the agent must coordinate with a simulated user to complete retail customer service tasks (order tracking, returns, address changes, cancellations) while following retail domain policies.
evaluation_method: pass^k (task success reliability across k repeated attempts); task completion rate
general_score_metric: pass^k (task success reliability); task completion rate
typical_sota_score: Frontier models achieve 40–65% task completion on retail domain; dual-control setting harder than original τ-bench retail (115-instance single-agent version)
reputation: Princeton University 2025; retail domain of τ²-bench; directly comparable to τ-bench retail but in the more challenging dual-control Dec-POMDP setting
notes: arXiv:2506.07982 (2025). τ²-bench extends τ-bench by introducing dual-control Dec-POMDP: both agent and user can take tool actions. Retail domain covers order management tasks. Directly extends τ-bench retail (COLM 2024) to the dual-control paradigm. HuggingFace: HuggingFaceH4/tau2-bench-data. Official repo: github.com/sierra-research/tau2-bench.
